repairs.promptText:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: transparent Stitched Hound idle game sprite
Input images: Image 1 is the front-three-quarter candidate and pose target. Image 2 is the existing idle palette/material reference. Image 3 is an existing attack frame palette and painterly-finish reference only.
Primary request: retain Image 1's exact front-three-quarter pose, quadruped anatomy, silhouette, head angle, feet placement, armor layout and curled tail. Repaint its materials and color treatment to match the original enemy set in Images 2 and 3: darker, matte charcoal iron; low-saturation tarnished copper/red seams; softer painterly shading and highlights. Keep only the eyes distinctly glowing red and keep seam glow subtle and contained to the seams. Reduce bright orange shine and orange outlines around the silhouette.
Subject invariants: same four-legged Stitched Hound with pointed canine ears, red eyes, dark iron plate armor, copper stitched seams, armored legs, and raised curved armored tail. Preserve the camera and foreshortened chest-forward orientation toward the viewer with the head turned slightly screen-left.
Constraints: change surface palette, material finish and lighting to match Images 2 and 3; preserve the current front-facing pose and recognizable armor identity. One full-body character only. Genuine transparent background with clean alpha, full paws and tail inside the canvas, no shadow or ground.
Avoid: side-profile rotation, anatomy or equipment changes, extra limbs, cropped toes, bright orange glowing piping, bright orange rim light, color fringe outside the silhouette, background, labels, effects or text.
